description: This file contains utility methods for handling grain interface types within the Orleans framework, including methods to retrieve interface methods, compute grain class type codes, and compare MethodInfo objects, all geared towards serialization and code generation tasks.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for working with grain interface types and their methods.

classes.name: MethodInfoComparer
classes.description: A singleton class implementing custom equality and comparison logic for MethodInfo objects based on method signatures.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant methods from a grain type, optionally only declared methods, including inherited interface methods.

methods.name: GetGrainClassTypeCode
methods.description: Computes a unique type code for a grain class based on its runtime type name.
